title: Appliance Rebates in Burlington 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Burlington appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 under Home Renovation Savings, with Burlington Hydro as distributor.
lead: Burlington's 73,180 households include 18% in tall apartment buildings, and the appliance page does not limit the rebates by home type.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Burlington
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: Apartments are not excluded by name

With 18% of Burlington households in buildings of five or more storeys, the lack of a home type on the appliance page matters. It lists a residential customer on the Ontario grid and does not mention condos, so owners should confirm before buying.

Burlington Hydro distributes power here, and Burlington postal codes begin with L, which the Energy Affordability Program lists for its free fridge and freezer route. The average January low is -7.2°C.

Unlike the thermostat rebate, the appliance page lists no home type. It asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. It does not address condos or apartments directly, so a Burlington condo owner or tenant should confirm with the program. 25% of Burlington households rent, and a tenant should ask the landlord before swapping a fridge or range that came with the unit.

The six rebates are $200 for a heat pump dryer, $150 for an induction cooktop or range, $75 for a washer, $50 each for a fridge and a freezer and $25 for a dishwasher. A household that replaced all six would receive $550, though few Burlington homes will need to swap everything at once. The rebate is flat, so it takes the same amount off an entry model and a premium one.
Most Efficient, not just ENERGY STAR

The rebate is for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient models, which the page describes as going beyond standard ENERGY STAR requirements. A fridge with the ordinary ENERGY STAR mark may not qualify. Each appliance has its own product list linked from the program page, so find the model number there before you pay, whether you buy in Burlington or online.

The program page asks for an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. A new fridge to go in a spare corner, or an induction range where the kitchen had no range, is not a replacement. If you are switching from gas to an electric appliance, the page does not say whether that counts, so ask the program before you buy. Burlington households that already cook on an electric range are the clearest fit for the induction rebate.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Does Burlington Hydro give an appliance rebate?
The page does not say. Ask the program.
Heat pump dryers, induction cooktops and ranges, washers, fridges, freezers and dishwashers.
